lyrics.text: Sweet child of mine, you got it all
Oh-oh, the mid-night train is leav-ing town
I can't wait for to-morrow's light
Cafe au lait and a Japanese dawn
Hold the line; keep the signal clean.
We were young, we were wrong, we were everything
Say it like you mean it!
Static on the radio, static in my head
Dont stop, dont stop, dont stop believing
Every little thing she does is magic
Some songs never find an end
